name: DANGEROUS NIGHT [FURNISH THE BUNKER]
desc:
DANGEROUS NIGHT
Are you ready to survive a world of nightmares? 😱

🪴🌦️🪴 NEW UPDATE [End of Winter] 🪴🌦️🪴
✅ ➤ New items added to the Night Crystal Exchange
✅ ➤ Performance & general optimizations
🎨🖌️ Use the Paintbrush tool to recolor your furniture!

🤝 Team up with friends to boost your chances!
👍 LIKE + FAVORITE for more updates!

Step into the shoes of a survivor who inherits an empty underground SHELTER — your only safe haven from the terrifying monsters that roam after dark. Experience true HORROR and intense SURVIVAL!

During the day, venture out to the nearby furniture market 🛋️ to FURNISH THE BUNKER — customize and transform it into a unique refuge. BUILD BASE, gather supplies, and upgrade your shelter to increase your chances of survival.

But beware: you must ESCAPE back to your bunker before nightfall! 🌃 Once darkness falls, the real nightmare begins. Will you survive another DANGEROUS NIGHT and create the ultimate sanctuary?
Inspired by 3008. 🚀
